name: Hakabyou -Kuwabiyau-
source:
The lead character wakes up in a locked room....finding a young girl look fainted, lying on the floor......

Not a happy place for a man and woman who do not know each other. He desperately wants to have sex with the girl before he dies in the room, but she hates him.

A great hentai adventure game!!
It is up to you which option you choose: Rape her, or Escape from the place with her.
Regardless which you choose, it is not going to be easy. Just take your choice and do your best.

50 CG pictures incl. alternate versions.
Voice is featured with over 700 lines.

Features:
Rape, Defloration, Forced internal ejaculation.
Gives her sexual pleasures before you and her die.

Escape
You do not have much time, but she hates him. Manage to cooperate with each other to escape from the place.

9 ending scenes are available. Voice is featured throughout the story.
Voice acted by Nagase Yuzuha. 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE028096.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公在一间上锁的房间里醒来……只见一个年轻女孩昏倒在地板上……

对一对素不相识的男女而言，这里绝不是什么愉快的地方。主人公迫切想在死于房间之前与女孩做爱，可她十分厌恶他。

一部精彩的成人冒险游戏！！
一切取决于你的选择：强暴她，还是和她一起逃离这里。
无论选择哪条路，都绝不会轻松。作出决定，然后竭尽全力吧。

收录50张CG，包含差分版本。
语音台词超过700句。

特色：
强暴、破处、强制内射。
在你和她死去之前，先让她体会性爱的快感。

逃脱
所剩时间不多，而她又十分厌恶主人公。想办法彼此合作，一同逃离这里。

游戏共有9种结局，故事全程配有语音。
配音：长濑柚叶。
